justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces include simple circular/oval motifs and reduce the human form to a schematic outline. Otherwise A is a single frontal anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief with symmetrical body ornament (a disc on the chest, banded and geometric fields), while B is a narrative multi-figure scene with silhouetted stick people holding objects, a large horned quadruped in profile, and figures standing above it — no shared composition, relationships or specific motifs.
